states.name: Basilisk
states.title: Master of Wraiths
states.description:
Born in a neighboring kingdom, Basilisk was abandoned soon after birth and taken in by an orphanage. She could never fit in with the other children, and she spent her days all alone.
Her loneliness was only broken when she came across a snake, which she named "Jajamaru". He became her one and only family, irreplaceable and precious above all else.

states.name: Basilisk
states.title: Master of Wraiths
states.description: Even after the kingdom fell and the orphanage was lost, Basilisk continued living together with Jajamaru in a cabin within a forest, surviving by hunting and foraging. But before too long, Jajamaru lost his life to illness. Overcome with grief, Basilisk chose to use her own body as a vessel to store Jajamaru's soul, allowing him to remain in this world as a wraith.

states.name: Basilisk
states.title: Master of Wraiths
states.description:
From then on, she lived quietly with Jajamaru in a forgotten ruin. Putting on a brave face, she called herself the "Master of Wraiths," but in the darkness of the caves, she spent most of her time terrified of intruders.

"Eek! I j-j-just felt a chill up my spine... Was that...a ghost?!"

Jajamaru: "It's just me, brat."
